props.description: The raw values, such as each order's total; non-numbers are left out.
props.name: values

props.description: The chart's accessible name and the data table's caption, such as "Order totals, October".
props.name: label

props.description: How many bins; Sturges' rule (1 + log2 of the count) by default.
props.name: binCount

props.description: The width of each bin, in the values' unit; it wins over `binCount`.
props.name: binWidth

props.description: How the bin edges are written, such as `{ style: "currency", currency: "SAR" }`.
props.name: valueFormat

props.description: The bars' colour; the first step of the accent ramp by default.
props.name: color

props.description: The plot's height in pixels; 240 by default.
props.name: height

props.description: Draws the count axis; off by default, since the tooltip and the data table carry the counts.
props.name: showValueAxis

props.description: Shows the pointed or pressed bin's count; on by default.
props.name: showTooltip
